The measurement-year window in ALCOHOL-SCREEN-ADULT-18 is assumed and declared as derived, so the rule requires human review.","Not represented: the second component, 'providing persons engaged in risky or hazardous drinking with brief behavioral counseling interventions to reduce unhealthy alcohol use'. It depends on screening results and on the clinician's judgment of risky or hazardous drinking, which structured EHR data would not reliably hold. It is also unclear whether it should be a separate rule.","'including pregnant women' is covered by the age-only denominator.
